notes.title: Mind Scanners turns 1! 🥳 Let's celebrate
notes.content:
[h2]Happy Birthday, Mind Scanners![/h2]

[b]The Structure turns 1 [/b] this Friday and we prepared some really cool things for you.
It has been a full year since we released Mind Scanners and thanks to you it has been a wild ride.
Being a political game with links to psychiatry, society & a very dystopian future, it sparked a lot of needed conversation around all these topics. 

Games can help us to reflect ourselves, our environment and the way we interact with each other. If a game is able to make you think, it does something very valuable. 
We talked about favourite devices with you, silly and interesting characters and how you try to solve problems that come up in this dark world. Let's just say the last year was never boring.

[b]Thank you for your reviews[/b] (they literally do a lot for us) and the ongoing support!

But what's a party without [b]EVENTS/STUFF/GIFTS[/b]?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/11f10560cb227a13111df0fe12c13addd8fbac1e.png[/img][b]40% Discount[/b]
This is the lowest discount Mind Scanners had so far, snack it while you can!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/b5c0a9e24715ae7422bc63b8581140e3f84d8852.png[/img][b]Stream & KEYS[/b]
YES we want to spend some time with you together in this haunting world, join us [b]today around 6PM BST[/b] and grab some keys.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/11f10560cb227a13111df0fe12c13addd8fbac1e.png[/img][b]Demo[/b]
We have our Demo up for you to try the game out if you're not so sure about the purchase yet, jump in and discover some parts of The Structure! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/b5c0a9e24715ae7422bc63b8581140e3f84d8852.png[/img][b]Trading Cards[/b]
The game has COMMUNITY ITEMS now 😎 [b]Emojis, Backgrounds & Trading cards[/b] to earn cool badges. The cards also come with neat little device instructions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/d1516b9c5163bac0316e1f71b353d6dfbf7b12ad.gif[/img]

Some [b]achievements[/b] for the team during the last year
We had a sparkling number of [b] 150.000 PLAYERS[/b] across all platforms! 
The game got into [b]GAMEPASS[/b] which was huge for us & also launched on [b]NINTENDO SWITCH![/b] 
On top it was [b]NOMINATED IN 5 CATEGORIES[/b] and [b]WON BEST NARRATIVE[/b] at the Danish Spilprisen Awards & [b]PUBLIC PRIZE[/b] at the Strasbourg European Fantastic Film Festival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/5b7e4547b43832aa6bcc48f1d9ad4249a0b7ecab.png[/img]

All that's left to say for us is that we hope you continue enjoying this universe and that being in the shoes of a Mind Scanner will forever be an experience that makes you think and reflect on these very important topics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/667b0e664f6ddc491ac94e54a056f9db7b546ca1.gif[/img]

Brave At Night & The Outer Zone xx
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1389550/

notes.title: Mind Scanners update + console launch 🥳
notes.content:
[h2][b]Fellow Scanners,[/b][/h2]

It's been a wild journey with our favourite dystopian psychiatry sim and we are very excited!
Here's why: 

[h3][b]FIRST THINGS FIRST[/b] 🤩[/h3]

We have a new update for you to snatch! 

- Expanded endings [spoiler]on the evil story path![/spoiler]
- New story events!! [spoiler]Players on the storyline path of helping The Structure will be given an extra tool[/spoiler]👀
- A handful of new smaller events for you to find!
- Balancing
- Bug fixes and polishing  

... Await you in the next version so don't hesitate to update your game.

[h3][b]ON TOP[/b] 🎮[/h3]

Today is the day Mind Scanners has its console launch. 🥳

You can play it now on:
- Xbox Game Pass
- Xbox Game Pass for PC
- Xbox One
- Nintendo Switch

We are psyched to deliver you console ports for Mind Scanners that do the different
devices justice. If you are already familiar with the game, you know what big part the several tools play in this world so we can't wait for you to try out this new experience using your own controller to literally treat the citizens of The Structure.

Thank you all for your support, we couldn't have done it without you.
Also every review on Steam is very much appreciated, so if you have the time, please
leave one! 🙏

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1389550/Mind_Scanners/

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/a6673cd0d6bcee852c7c74a4f81b16443f6a6fe5.jpg[/img]

Fellow Mind Scanners,

Buckle up and grab your devices, here are some amazing news! 💥

Mind Scanners is packed with stunning arcade-like minigames and
soon you'll be able to treat your patients on a big (or small!) screen from the comfort of your sofa or armchair because:

notes.title: New FREE content update! 🧠
notes.content:
[b]Fellow Scanners,[/b]
We have been blown away with how well Mind Scanners has been received and during the past few months we have been super hard at work to prepare something ✨very cool✨ for you to enjoy:

[h2]TIME TO GET TO KNOW YOUR NEW DEVICES![/h2]

The next time you launch your favourite brain scanning game, you will be greeted with the biggest update we have ever made!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/b5c0a9e24715ae7422bc63b8581140e3f84d8852.png[/img]NEW DEVICE: [b]Hemolyzer[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/11f10560cb227a13111df0fe12c13addd8fbac1e.png[/img]ANOTHER NEW DEVICE: [b]Stroboshocker 😲[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/b5c0a9e24715ae7422bc63b8581140e3f84d8852.png[/img][b]Brand new event[/b] in the game - can you find it?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/ec06a656b85c0107585bc907d3b158e8c14dab01.png[/img]A LOT of bug fixes, adjustments and polishing on the UI and balancing

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Want to see what it's all about? Watch us stream the game over on our Steam store page!


The Structure and our great leader provides every Mind Scanner with [b]two new efficient devices[/b], 
that you'll need for future treatment of your patients. [b]📢 Absolutely safe to use of course.[/b]

[h3]HEMOLYZER[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/dfa466e79d7373f067e6c8b042df062016e453cc.gif[/img]

[i][b]Hemolyzer[/b] sucks out the blood of the patient, detects any imbalance and shoots a cleansing substitute fluid back into the patient. Use the sliders to match the shape of the blood sample – Absolutely not dangerous at all![/i]

[h3]STROBOSHOCKER[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38831602/8d32f6a8afbc05e9528616ac45c50e763e6d97e7.gif[/img]

[i][b]Stroboshocker[/b] keeps the patient in balance with amplified light drawn from luminescent zygnoka crystals. Follow the instructions to fill the luma-meter – Always think of your patient![/i]
[hr][/hr] 
There is a [b]new event[/b] in the game for you to find and enjoy. We fixed some bugs too to make sure your gaming experience is on the same level as your expertise as a Mind Scanner!

If you want to take a look at the new devices, check out our
[url=https://youtu.be/gF0cx_C7qSE]Tutorial Update Video[/url] OR jump directly into the game!

[b]WHAT?! [/b]You still haven't grabbed Mind Scanners? Well, now is the best chance to grab the game with the freshly baked devices at it's 
[h2]BIGGEST DISCOUNT YET:[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1389550/Mind_Scanners/

Grab your scanner, meet your patients and explore The Structure!
Get to work Mind Scanner.

notes.title: More fixes and tweaks
notes.content:
[b]For your convenience:[/b]
You can now leave treatment to repack your bag and resume treatment immediately as long as no insanity points have been removed.
Logo video intro can now be skipped on ESC. This is mostly intended for players who can't load the videos for some reason. Skipping the video intro won't make the game load much faster on most systems as the game is already loading in the background while the videos are playing.

[b]Balancing:[/b]
Slightly more insanty on hard mode.
ROBOTANY made easier.
Cooldown changes:
[list]
[*]Electrigger cooldown now stacks with other cooldowns
[*]ECHOPUNCTURE cooldown now depends on the number of insanity points you remove.
[*]HYPNAMID cooldown slightly increased to not allow back to back uses.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
Trauma Bomb + Ease Pill
Mouse issues
Text alignment

notes.title: Your Quality of Life has been improved
notes.content:
[b]Small new features to improve the life of any Mind Scanner:[/b]
[list]
[*]Easy swap and reorder devices in device manager.
[*]A device can no longer be interrupted while it is just about to deliver its effect.
[*]You can now also delete your [i]current[/i] profile.
[/list]
[b]Device changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]5 new mazes added to MIND MAZE.
[*]LUNA SUCKER made slightly easier.
[*]Improved Russian and Chinese localization for REFLECTOR (word device).
[/list]
[b]Balance changes:[/b] Slightly shorter traveldistances and more available patients at any given time.

[b]Gamebreaking bugs have been fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*]Mouse issues on a multiple monitor setup.
[*]Better handling of currupted/missing save files.
[*]Game will skip video intro if video can't be played.
[/list]
[b]Minor bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed time pausing exploits with book of Lunacy.
[*]Some missing sprites have been hooked up.
[*]Fixed interaction edgecases of different devices.
[*]UI tweaks.
[/list]

notes.title: New Difficulty Settings and localization fixes
notes.content:
Hi all! A New patch is now up and apart from some minor bugs, we have now added a difficulty setting!
When you start a new game, you will be now able to select a difficulty setting from the main menu.

If you already have an existing save, you will not be able to change the difficulty setting for that particular playthrough.

Here are some notes on what is different in the different difficulty settings:
[list]
[*] maintenance amount
[*] starting kapok amount
[*] symptom points amount
[*] travel time
[*] device cost
[*] auto-balanging thresholds (when will the auto balancer try to make life easier or harder for you)
[*] the penalty for answering wrong in mind scan is also different: 5/10/15
[/list]

Best wishes,
Brave At Night & The Outer Zone
